5 15-12-2023 Interlocutory Application No. 01 of 2023
The instant interlocutory application has been filed under Section 5 of the Indian Limitation Act for condoning the delay of 9 months and 21 days in filing the present Miscellaneous appeal.
2. Learned counsel for the appellants submits that petitioner had no knowledge about the judgment dated 21-10-2022 and award dated 06-12-2022.

It is further submitted that the conducting lawyer of the appellants in the Tribunal did not inform about the outcome of the case, due to which the appellants remained in dark and were under the assumption that the matter is still pending.

It is next submitted that in the month of June, 2023 the appellants received summons with respect to Claim Execution Case No. 05 of 2023, in which, the date was Patna High Court MA No.744 of 2023(5) dt.15-12-2023 fixed as 05-07-2023 for their appearance.
The concerned advocate filed requisition for certified copy of the judgment and award, which was supplied on 13-10-2023.
Thereafter, the present appeal has been filed.

3. Considering the aforesaid facts and circumstances of the case as well as averments made in the interlocutory application and submissions made in support thereof, delay in filing the instant appeal is condoned.

Interlocutory Application No. 2 of 2023 5. This interlocutory application has filed under Order 41 Rule 5 read with Section 151 of the Code of Civil Procedure for staying the further proceedings of Claim Execution Case No. 05 of 2023 arising out of MACT Case No. 21 of 2013 pending in the Court of the Additional District Judge-III-cum- Motor Accident Claim Tribunal, Jamui.

entities.text: Court of the Additional District Judge-III-cum- Motor Accident Claim Tribunal, Jamui
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
6. The learned counsel for the appellants submits that the appellants are manufacturers and he draws the attention of this Court towards page 5 of the impugned judgment, wherein the learned Tribunal found the chassis number of the offending Hero Honda Glamor vehicle as '07GAWC09396'
and the said vehicle had no valid registration number and was being used Patna High Court MA No.744 of 2023(5) dt.15-12-2023 unregistered by the Company itself and held that O.P. Nos. 3 & 4 (
appellants) with driver (O.P. No.2) are jointly responsible to pay the compensation amount.

7. The claimants filed Execution case bearing Claim Execution Case No. 5 of 2023, which is pending before the Court of the Additional District Judge-III-cum- Motor Accident Claim Tribunal, Jamui for execution of the Award.

entities.text: Additional District Judge-III-cum- Motor Accident Claim Tribunal, Jamui
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
8. Issue notice in stay petition (I.A. No. 02/2023) as well as in main Appeal to the Respondent Nos.
1 to 4, for which requisites etc. under speed post with AD as well as under ordinary process must be filed within a period of one week.
9.

In the meantime, further proceedings of Claim Execution Case No. 05 of 2023, arising out of MACT Case No. 21 of 2013, pending in the Court of the Additional District Judge-III-cum-Motor Accident Claim Tribunal, Jamui, shall remain stayed.
